newsitem.title: USA: Fed stays out of open market, funds remain soft.
newsitem.headline: Fed stays out of open market, funds remain soft.

text.p: The Federal Reserve refrained from intervening in the open market on Wednesday, mildly surprising analysts who expected at least a round of overnight system repurchase agreements.
Federal funds stayed below the 5-1/2 percent target rate at 5-7/16 percent.
On Tuesday the Fed added $2.10 billion in reserves via overnight system RPs.
Analysts forecast about a $6 billion a day add need in the maintenance period that ends August 13, and had forecast either overnight or 5-day system RPs this session.
One said that it appears the Fed is taking a "day-by-day approach" to the banking system.
